explanation: Q1 returns drinkers who only get beers they like at every bar they frequent. Q2 returns drinkers who have at least one beer they like served at a bar they frequent. A drinker who frequents a bar serving both liked and disliked beers will appear in Q2 but not Q1.
counterexample_dsp: Drinker Alice frequents Bar1. Bar1 serves BeerA (liked by Alice) and BeerB (not liked). Q2 returns Alice (she likes BeerA at Bar1), Q1 excludes her (Bar1 serves BeerB she doesn't like).
